note: *vos mentirão os vossos inimigos* (17:46's verb), subject moved last for the stylist. The blind reader did not hear the feigned submission; *vos prestarão falsa homenagem* is the explaining option.
*os que o exasperam*: the *o* is supplied to the absolute *exásperant*, refused by both Latinist runs and held as grammar (D2), since *exasperar* wants an object. *os que exasperam* is the option.
*e o exaltei*: the same supplied *o* for the absolute *exaltávi*, refused by both Latinist runs and held as grammar (D2). *e exaltei* is the option.
